name: Supplies to Auberdine
summary: Supplies to Auberdine is an escort mission where Alliance adventurers protect Feero Ironhand as he carries critical provisions and messages from Maestra's Post northward toward Darkshore. Given the growing menace radiating from the Tower of Althalaxx and the presence of hostile infiltrators in Ashenvale, safe passage cannot be taken for granted.

sections.title: A Perilous Road North
sections.body: Maestra's Post sits on the western frontier of Ashenvale, a quiet outpost caught between the wild tensions of the forest and the troubled lands of Darkshore. Following investigations into the sinister activity surrounding the Tower of Althalaxx, Delgren the Purifier gathers vital supplies and intelligence bound for Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine. Rather than risking solitary couriers, the outpost relies on armed escorts to accompany Feero Ironhand as he treks along the forest road.

sections.title: Shadows Along the Trail
sections.body: The journey reveals just how compromised the wilderness around the road has become. Feero's route is beset by coordinated ambushes. Cultists of the Dark Strand seek to silence any reports regarding their demonic rituals, Forsaken scouts stalk the woodland underbrush, and vicious commanders such as Balizar the Umbrage, Aligar the Tormentor, and Caedakar the Vicious attempt to cut down the caravan before it reaches the border.

faq.answer: Feero Ironhand is a human courier stationed at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. Entrusted by Delgren the Purifier to carry important messages and logistical aid to Auberdine, he is cautious enough to refuse to travel without capable bodyguards.

faq.q: Why does Auberdine need these supplies?
faq.answer: Darkshore and northern Ashenvale face rising corruption and threats from demonic cultists operating out of the Tower of Althalaxx. The night elf Sentinels stationed in Auberdine, led locally by figures like Sentinel Starbreeze, need fresh provisions and up-to-date intelligence to maintain their defense of the coast.

faq.q: Who attacks Feero along the road?
faq.answer: Feero warns that dangerous foes operate throughout the forest and asks for guards. The identities of those who attack are discovered during the escort.

faq.q: What is the connection to the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier has been orchestrating efforts to uncover and disrupt the dark rituals of the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. This escort is the culmination of that investigative chain, ensuring that intelligence and vital support reach the Night Elf leadership in Auberdine.

faq.q: Where do I report after protecting Feero?
aliases: where do i go after escorting feero
faq.answer: After seeing Feero safely through the ambushes in Ashenvale, you report back to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post to confirm the delivery succeeded.

angles.text: Safeguarding this corridor ensures that the outposts in Ashenvale remain connected to Auberdine's logistical hub, preserving the Alliance's fragile hold on northern Kalimdor.
The supplies and dispatches sent north directly aid the Sentinels in Auberdine as they contend with growing darkness across Darkshore and along the Ashenvale border.
Feero Ironhand represents human willingness to support kaldorei allies deep within unfamiliar, dangerous ancient forests.
